Chevron's net margin in fiscal Q1 2025 was about 7.6%, using figures I'm recalling from memory rather than checking against the filing, so treat it as an estimate.

- Net income attributable to Chevron was about $3.5 billion.
- Sales and other operating revenues were about $46.1 billion.

Net margin = 3.5 / 46.1 ≈ 7.6%.

If total revenues and other income (which also includes equity-affiliate income and other income) were used as the denominator, the margin would be somewhat lower, roughly 7.3% to 7.5%.
